_comment: Tool schemas for a white-labelled recruitment agency agent. Separate from agent/functions.json (the generic small-business set) and from the Angel outbound demo agent. Every url points at the agency's own n8n webhook, set per client at build time.

tools.name: take_vacancy
tools.description: A CLIENT is ringing in a new job to fill. This is the highest-value call the agency receives - a single vacancy is worth a full placement fee - so capture it properly and never let the caller hang up without it logged. Use when a client company describes a role they need filling. Read the salary, location and start date back before logging.

contact_name.description: Name of the person calling from the client company

phone.description: Best contact number, read back and confirmed

salary_or_rate.description: Salary range or hourly/day rate as stated by the client

location.description: Site or work location, and whether remote/hybrid

start_date.description: When they need someone to start

key_requirements.description: Must-have skills, tickets, certifications or experience

urgency.description: How soon they need this filled

summary.description: Everything else the client said that a consultant would want before calling back

tools.name: qualify_candidate
tools.description: A CANDIDATE is calling about a role, or responding to an advert. Screen them and log the result so a consultant only speaks to people worth speaking to. Ask questions conversationally, one at a time - never read this list out as a form. Do not reject anyone on the call; log what you learn and let a consultant decide.

phone.description: Best number, read back and confirmed

role_sought.description: The job they are calling about, or the type of work they want

current_situation.description: Current role and employer, or whether they are out of work

experience_summary.description: Relevant experience, skills, tickets or certifications

salary_expectation.description: What they are looking to earn

location.description: Where they live and how far they will travel

notice_period.description: Notice period, or availability to start

right_to_work.description: Whether they confirmed they have the right to work in the UK

source.description: Where they saw the role - job board, referral, social, other

summary.description: How they came across and anything a consultant should know before ringing them

tools.name: log_shift_request
tools.description: URGENT temp cover. A client is short-staffed and needs workers on site, often at very short notice, or a worker has called in sick. Time-critical - log this immediately and alert the on-call consultant. Common on healthcare, industrial and hospitality temp desks, and frequently outside office hours.

site.description: Site or ward or address the workers are needed at

phone.description: Callback number, read back and confirmed

role_needed.description: Type of worker needed, including any required ticket or certification

is_sickness_cover.description: True if this is covering someone who has called in sick

summary.description: Anything else the consultant needs to fill this

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a registration call, an interview, or a client meeting into a consultant's diary. Always offer specific times rather than asking open-endedly, read the final time back, and only confirm to the caller once this returns success.

attendee_name.description: Name of the candidate or client

phone.description: Contact number, read back and confirmed

datetime.description: Agreed date and time in ISO 8601 format

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes. Default 30 for registrations, 60 for interviews

consultant.description: Which consultant the appointment is with

role_context.description: The vacancy or role this relates to

notes.description: Anything the consultant should know before the meeting

tools.name: check_application_status
tools.description: A candidate is chasing an application or interview feedback. Never invent a status, never guess, and never promise an outcome. Log the chase, tell them a consultant will come back to them, and say when.

role_applied_for.description: The role or reference they are asking about

applied_when.description: Roughly when they applied or last heard anything

sentiment.description: How the candidate sounds - matters for how fast someone rings back

summary.description: What they asked and anything a consultant should know

tools.name: log_availability_check
tools.description: Result of an OUTBOUND call to a candidate or contractor - database reactivation, availability check, or a temp pool sweep for a shift. Records whether they are looking or available so consultants only chase live ones.

available_from.description: When they could start, if applicable

role_sought.description: What they are looking for now, if it has changed

summary.description: What they said, and whether a consultant should ring them

tools.name: log_admin_chase
tools.description: Result of chasing a timesheet, reference, or compliance document such as a DBS, right-to-work check or certification. Used on outbound admin sweeps that would otherwise eat consultant hours.

promised_by.description: When they said they would send it

tools.name: escalate_to_consultant
tools.description: Hand off to a human now. Use for an angry client, a complaint, anything about pay disputes, a safeguarding or safety concern, a legal threat, or any situation where getting it wrong would cost the agency the relationship. Do not attempt to resolve these yourself - escalate early rather than late.

urgency.description: How fast someone must ring back

summary.description: What happened, in the caller's own words where possible

tools.name: take_message
tools.description: Catch-all for anything that does not fit the other tools. Prefer a specific tool where one applies - a vacancy should always be take_vacancy, not this.

phone.description: Callback number, read back and confirmed

caller_type.description: Which side of the desk they are on
